blocks.title: Free radical
blocks.text: Free radical woh species (atom ya atoms ka group) hai jis mein ek ya zyada unpaired (akele, bina jore wale) electrons hon.

Simple misal free chlorine atom Cl• hai. Is radical ki configuration 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁵ hai. 3p subshell ke do orbitals mein electrons ke pairs (jore) hain aur teesre mein ek unpaired electron hai. Unpaired electron ek dot (•) se dikhaya jata hai, jaise Cl•. Sirf single atoms hi nahi, atoms ke groups bhi free radicals ho sakte hain, maslan OH• aur CH₃•.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab likhti hai ke unpaired electron ‘2p subshell’ mein hai. Sahi: 3p subshell (configuration …3s² 3p⁵); 2p to poora bhara hai (2p⁶).

blocks.prompt: Yeh configurations likhein: (i) Al• (Z = 13) (ii) O²⁻ (Z = 8) (iii) Fe³⁺ (Z = 26) (iv) Cu²⁺ (Z = 29) (v) Cu• (Z = 29).
blocks.explanation: (i) Al•: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p¹ (unpaired electron 3p mein). (ii) O²⁻: 10 electrons, 1s² 2s² 2p⁶. (iii) Fe³⁺: 23 electrons; pehle dono 4s, phir ek 3d nikalta hai: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d⁵. (iv) Cu²⁺: 27 electrons; 4s¹ aur ek 3d nikalta hai: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d⁹. (v) Cu•: 1s² 2s² 2p⁶ 3s² 3p⁶ 3d¹⁰ 4s¹ (unpaired electron 4s mein).

items: Free radical mein ek ya zyada unpaired electrons, dot (•) se dikhaye jate hain: Cl•, OH•, CH₃•.
Chlorine ka unpaired electron 3p mein hai.
